_comment: Was TRANSFORM_HERO target:'Ash'. TRANSFORM_HERO is Arakni's "you become a random Agent of Chaos" and does not read a target, so this card turned YOUR HERO into an Agent of Chaos and left the ash alone -- the fourth card to author the hero effect when it meant the permanent one. "Target ash" is not "up to", so up_to is false: with no ash the play does nothing rather than transforming something else.
